summary: @or-sdk/notifications ships an install-time Bun-runtime dropper executing an obfuscated payload unrelated to the package's advertised purpose
details: The package's `preinstall` hook runs `setup.mjs`, an obfuscator.io-style script (hex-named identifiers, wrapper dictionaries) that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases and uses it via `execFileSync` to execute a bundled sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, large numeric constants array, string-array shuffle) — an opaque install-time payload whose name and behavior have no relation to the package's advertised purpose as a notifications SDK. Installing the package on default settings causes this obfuscated payload to run under a freshly downloaded alternate runtime, bypassing Node-based instrumentation. The package is published on public npm as `@or-sdk/notifications` while its CHANGELOG links exclusively to `gitlab.internal.onereach.io/onereach/platform/or-sdk-next`, indicating the real upstream is an internal OneReach SDK and this public-registry release impersonates that private scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
